description: 臺中市獨居老人緊急救援守護連線系統 [fire, police and emergency services] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 臺中市政府社會局. 獨居老人緊急救援系統服務為保障獨居長者生命安全，於家中裝設主機與隨身按鈕，守護中心24小時全天候監測求救訊息，視服務對象需要，提供意外事件及緊急事件單位之聯繫，並進行緊急事件聯絡人之通知與後續處理狀況之追蹤。. Coverage: 臺中市政府社會局. The portal files it under the publisher 臺中市政府社會局. Its tags are 老年安養. It offers 1 resource(s) in xml, json, csv. The portal shows 2026-03-18 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
